headline: Moderate outlook for long outages in Hidalgo County
summary: Homes in Hidalgo County lose power for 12 hours or more about once every 8 years. That comes from 8 years of records since 2018. The largest outage here began on February 14, 2021. At its peak, 16% of homes in the county were dark. For a home with gas heat, one Core lasts about 20 hours in August and about 51 hours in February. We suggest two Cores. That would have covered 88% of past long outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
